reason: A flomo integration plugin that lets agents configure credentials, check connection status, and send notes or summaries to the external flomo service.

summaries.zh: 通过代理工具和设置面板配置 flomo，并将笔记、备忘录和摘要发送到浮墨笔记。
summaries.en: Configures flomo and lets agents send notes, memos, and summaries to the service through agent tools and a settings panel.

capabilities: Sends notes, memos, and summaries to the flomo external service
Stores and manages a flomo API key or webhook URL locally
Provides configuration, status, testing, clearing, and quick-send functions through agent tools and a settings panel
